message.content: I'll buy Oriental Avenue. Cash stays above the St. James reserve, and the light blues are still fully open.
message.reasoning:
The user wants to play Monopoly.

Evaluating whether to buy Oriental Avenue or start an auction. I own two of the three orange properties but still need St. James Place to complete the monopoly. The light blue group is completely unowned.

I will buy Oriental Avenue. After purchasing it and St. James Place, I will have $234 remaining. This keeps me cash-rich for building houses on the orange group.

$234 is too tight for a full orange house build. I am now weighing an auction for Oriental Avenue, since the opponent has $1705 and will likely buy every unowned property.

A light blue monopoly is cheap and powerful. All three properties cost only $320 total. Houses there are just $50 each. I could mortgage the light blue set later if needed. The opponent has $1705 and will fight for every unowned property.

I will buy Oriental Avenue for $100. An auction would let the opponent acquire it cheaply and establish a foothold. I have enough cash to afford the purchase without hurting my orange build plans.
